integrity: Definitions distinguish the full strong Morse complex from the ordinary Morse, ordinary matching, and pure strong complexes. The all-parameter claim follows from an exact facet identity and nullhomotopic cone attachments; the standalone finite checker is corroboration, not the proof. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional friendship graphs and full strong matching complexes only; no equivariant homotopy assertion, no general windmill cycle-length extension, and no comparison-map computation. Finite tests cover \(1\leq m\leq4\); the universal proof is symbolic.
title: Strong Morse complexes of friendship graphs: an exponential sphere-wedge formula
